WARRIORPATH VISUAL QC REPORT — warriorpath.ai

EXECUTED: Visual QC pipeline (Quick + Crawl modes)
TARGET: https://warriorpath.ai
MODE: Layer 1 (Programmatic) + Layer 2 (Visual) + Layer 2.5 (Animation) + Layer 3 (Interaction)

=== VERDICT: FAIL ===

Blocking Issues Found:
• [HIGH] 1 element with near-invisible text (contrast ratio < 1.5:1)
• [MEDIUM] 4 elements fail WCAG AA contrast (need 4.5:1, have as low as 2.1:1)

=== WHAT PASSED (20 checks) ===
✓ HTTP status OK
✓ Zero console errors
✓ Zero network failures
✓ Page has content (not empty)
✓ Tailwind classes valid (no ghost classes)
✓ Images loaded successfully
✓ Accessibility basics (ARIA, landmarks, headings)
✓ No overflow on mobile/tablet/desktop
✓ Content exists across all breakpoints
✓ Animations: 0 suspicious infinite, 18 transitions reasonable
✓ No layout thrashing during transitions
✓ Smooth rendering: 61fps avg, 0 dropped frames
✓ Layout stable (CLS: 0)
✓ Form inputs visible
✓ Clickable elements have proper size
✓ No occluded click targets

=== SITE DISCOVERY ===
Crawl found only 1 page: / (root)
Likely cause: App requires authentication to access candidate/HQ/field routes

=== ANALYSIS ===
The contrast failures are WCAG AA violations that impact accessibility. The dark-themed NSW aesthetic may be using gray-on-black text that's too subtle.

=== RECOMMENDATION ===
Before client handoff:
1. Fix near-invisible text element (likely footer or subtle UI)
2. Adjust 4 failing contrast elements to meet 4.5:1 ratio minimum
3. Re-run visual QC to confirm PASS

The app is structurally sound (no console errors, good performance) but needs color accessibility fixes.
